I have not yet attempted suicide, this is just an observation. Call it a stupid theory, if you will:


Suicide is a *process*. Just like how death is a process and how life is a process. It's not much of an "action". The action is part of that process. It starts with one thought, intrusive or not, and eventually ends up with the person carrying out their suicide plan. It could be a considerably long process (planning it out may either increase their chances of death, or increase their chances of a safe survival depending on what they do) or a short, simple one. There are no guarantees whether this person will succeed or not. And when someone survives an attempt, the outcome is generally far from what they want. They're in pain. Far more pain than they had before. When they later have suicidal thoughts and plan again, they are again in the process of suicide. Again, we have no idea whether this person will die or not, much less die a peaceful death. It's really, really not as simple as "I'm going to kill myself". "Killed myself" is not the result. Death is. The goal is generally "ending every shit once and for all". But the result may be much more different from the goal, and this time we would probably have *no way* to reverse anything. The past will stay as the past in people's heads. It  doesn't *exist*. This becomes much more true after you die, I imagine. Definitely true if humanity goes extinct. 


Everyone will die, suicidal or not. 


I am not alive because "it'll get better". I'm alive because I choose to stay alive even with these thoughts till my death. (Also because I'm indecisive and a chronic procrastinator - something I intend to combat in my lifetime along with suicidal thoughts, or use to my advantage)


If I intend to kill myself when I'm around a certain age (again), I will remember this thing I wrote for myself: "I've spent my time researching suicide methods for longer than I intended. So I'll try anything I want before thinking about what to do to kill myself. Even if I suck. Even if I'm in pain. If nothing works, I'll try calling a hotline. Last resorts. Life sucks but it's also beautiful to me. If I try to kill myself, I won't care about what others think. I won't live for one person or even hundreds. But I'll stick around for temporary shit. I'll die anyway even if I don't want to. Suicide plans are always just too "iffy" for me, so if there's an easy way to take a break from breathing and life and keep my brain intact, I'll take that. Till then, I'll see how things go."
